title: Delhi PM2.5 Analysis (2022)
text: V5GL04 NetCDF files store data [lon, lat] order — reverse terra expects ([lat, lon]). Loading entire 121 MB global array just extract Delhi extremely slow. two helpers read pixels covering Delhi’s bounding box, making extraction near-instant.
code: read_v5gl04_fast <- function(nc_path, shape) {   bbox    <- sf::st_bbox(shape)   nc      <- ncdf4::nc_open(nc_path)   lons    <- ncdf4::ncvar_get(nc, "lon")   lats    <- ncdf4::ncvar_get(nc, "lat")   lon_idx <- which(lons >= bbox["xmin"] & lons <= bbox["xmax"])   lat_idx <- which(lats >= bbox["ymin"] & lats <= bbox["ymax"])   data    <- ncdf4::ncvar_get(     nc, "GWRPM25",     start = c(min(lon_idx), min(lat_idx)),     count = c(length(lon_idx), length(lat_idx))   )   ncdf4::nc_close(nc)   mean(data, na.rm = TRUE) }  load_v5gl04_rast <- function(year, month, shape) {   nc_path <- sprintf(     "/NAS/climatehealth/WUSTL_PM2.5/V5GL04/Global/Monthly/V5GL04.HybridPM25.Global.%04d%02d-%04d%02d.nc",     year, month, year, month   )   bbox    <- sf::st_bbox(shape)   nc      <- ncdf4::nc_open(nc_path)   lons    <- ncdf4::ncvar_get(nc, "lon")   lats    <- ncdf4::ncvar_get(nc, "lat")   lon_idx <- which(lons >= bbox["xmin"] & lons <= bbox["xmax"])   lat_idx <- which(lats >= bbox["ymin"] & lats <= bbox["ymax"])   data    <- ncdf4::ncvar_get(     nc, "GWRPM25",     start = c(min(lon_idx), min(lat_idx)),     count = c(length(lon_idx), length(lat_idx))   )   ncdf4::nc_close(nc)   r <- terra::rast(     nrows = length(lat_idx), ncols = length(lon_idx),     xmin  = min(lons[lon_idx]), xmax = max(lons[lon_idx]),     ymin  = min(lats[lat_idx]), ymax = max(lats[lat_idx]),     crs   = "EPSG:4326"   )   terra::values(r) <- t(data)[nrow(t(data)):1, ]   r }
